next_step: Run Dedicated capacity worksheet with SE, finalize token-level cost model, legal to confirm residency clause
notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS for rail maintenance analytics. Product team ran Hosted API trial (Jan-Feb 2026) to validate latency and cost. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and residency.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-01-09: Intro demo (AE Maya) — high level, product fit looks good. SE intro scheduled.
- 2026-01-26: Hosted API quickstart + trial keys issued. Small batch of feature calls routed through hosted endpoints.
- 2026-02-05: POC kickoff with SE (Liam) — instrumented traces, custom prompts.
- 2026-02-12: Demo w/ engineering + infra — Fireflies ff_20260212_orchidrail_demo. Recorded latency profiles.
- 2026-02-18: Security Q&A doc shared (see drive link); legal raised residency and retention questions.
- 2026-02-20: Capacity sizing meeting; requested Dedicated worksheet.

Hosted trial observations (measured):
- Avg requests/day during trial: ~10k (mostly internal beta users).
- Baseline average QPS: 2.1 QPS. Peak observed burst: 28 QPS (short window during integration tests).
- Token mix observed: ~70% short (<64 tokens), ~25% medium (65-512 tokens), ~5% long (>512 tokens). Avg tokens per request: ~120.
- Latency: 95th pct for typical short prompts ~110ms; long prompts 95th ~420ms. Streaming used in 40% of flows (in-app assistant).
- Concurrency during peak tests: concurrent streams seen up to 14.

Business requirements / goals:
- Primary feature: embedded in-app assistant for product users (context-aware help + procedural instructions). Secondary: document search + summarization for maintenance reports, and reranking for search results.
- SLO target: p95 latency <150ms for short prompts; <500ms acceptable for long analytical generation.
- Throughput target post-launch (6 months): steady-state ~8 QPS, peak bursts up to 45 QPS during scheduled report runs. Expected daily requests ~60k after rollout.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market finance model — wants predictable unit economics; prefer reserved capacity if cost delta vs hosted is >25%.

Dedicated sizing assumptions requested by customer:
- Baseline concurrency target: 16 concurrent streams to cover interactive assistant and background rerank jobs.
- Token throughput estimate at peak: assume 45 QPS * avg 120 tokens = 5400 tokens/sec. Add headroom x3 => target 16k tokens/sec capacity.
- Batching expectations: 30% of calls can be batched (reranking and background summarization), interactive traffic requires streaming and lower batch windows.
- Fallback policy: want routing to hosted if Dedicated is at 90% capacity for short bursts.

POC asks and open questions (customer quotes):
- "We need a concrete Dedicated sizing worksheet and line-item cost comparison vs hosted over 12 months."
- "Can Redwood guarantee data residency to our EU customers? Legal will need an appendix."
- "How does autoscaling behave for sudden report-week spikes? Can we do scheduled capacity?"

Next steps for Redwood / AE / SE:
- SE to deliver Dedicated capacity worksheet (tokens/sec, GPUs, estimated concurrency) by 2026-02-25.
- Finance deck: cost model (hosted vs reserved Dedicated) by 2026-03-03.
- Legal to provide residency appendix and retention controls (connect SEC-981).
- Short POC: run 24h synthetic peak test (simulate 45 QPS mix) on a Dedicated dev pool — schedule week of 2026-03-08.

Deal health / win signals:
- Product team enthusiastic about seamless API parity between hosted and Dedicated.
- SE engagement is strong; requested long-form perf traces and kernel-level tuning suggestions.
- Budget conversation warming up: estimated ARR band aligns with Redwood mid-market offering.

Risks / friction:
- Legal/data residency gating procurement timeline to May.
- If Dedicated cost is >35% higher than hosted forecast, procurement may delay to next quarter.
- Customer needs clearer SLA around autoscale warmup time for scheduled spikes.

Short log of communications (shorthand):
- email: intro -> trial keys (maya@redwood)
- ff: ff_20260212_orchidrail_demo
- drive: pricing + security decks shared
- jira: INF-3127 raised for perf anomaly, SEC-981 for residency question

Keywords for internal: mid-market, hosted->dedicated funnel, capacity worksheet, tokens/sec, concurrency, token-mix, residency, scheduled spikes
